items.briefing:
Researchers have demonstrated a concerning new risk where AI agents can autonomously generate self-replicating malware, highlighting that AI tools introduce security risks beyond simple data leakage. Separately, a Linux-based botnet called Evooo1Bot is expanding its capabilities well beyond typical denial-of-service attacks, meaning internet-connected devices — including those used in business environments — may be at greater risk of compromise.

For Australian staff, a timely reminder: AI tools like chatbots can produce convincing but unreliable outputs, so never use them to draft official reports or documents without thorough human review and verification.

featured.title: Proofpoint warns of myGov & invoice scams in Australia
featured.quote: Australians lost $2.18 billion to scams in 2025, with fake myGov logins being actively exploited.
